channel.title: Berdandy's Catalog

item.description:
Making Angry Paintbrush felt like making my first "real" album, rather than just some random things I made that I mushed together in an arbitrary order.
There's a LITTLE more thought behind Angry. Just a little.
Enjoy!
item.title: Berdandy – Angry Paintbrush - EP

item.description: Drip Drop is my debut album, aptly named after the IV drip I was hooked up to for most of its production. It's a bit of a wild journey, drawing inspiration from funk, house, d'n'b, dubstep, and dropping an arcade machine down the stairs.
item.title: Berdandy – Drip Drop - EP

item.description: To top the trip off, the skies opened up and rained on us as we cycled up the desert mountain trail. Apparently it only rains a couple of times a year there.
